text:
jen: heads-up — I merged PR #8421 ~10m ago and main just turned red in the smoke-gpu matrix. If this is my change happy to revert but wanted to ping infra first. /cc @alex

ci-bot: build 4991234567 failed: smoke-gpu (shard 2) — failing tests: tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction_logic (3 failures). logs: https://ci.redwood/4991234567/logs

oliver: :eyes: can someone kick a rerun? might be a transient GPU flake

maya: I can queue a rerun but it may hit the same shard. any useful log snippets from the failure?

sam: queued quick rerun: `ci rerun 4991234567 --shards 2` — started

jen: note: my commit touched allocator batching and also included a minor cudnn vendor bump. worried about kernel alloc interactions

oliver: from the logs the immediate error is an OOM inside `kv_cache_allocate` then an assertion: `expected free >= needed` — snippet:
``
E   RuntimeError: GPU OOM while allocating kv cache
AssertionError: expected free (120MB) >= needed (256MB)
```

maya: that reads like a kvalloc regression. @alex do you own kvalloc?

alex: grabbing logs now, oncall pinged. if rerun still fails we should bisect the last few merges and prepare a revert PR.

ops-bot: autoscaler noticed a spike in GPU allocation after merge, scaled up 2 nodes (2026-03-18T15:22:10Z) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sam: rerun finished — still red on the same test shard. rerun id 4991234578

jen: ack. starting fast bisect across recent merges (PR #8418, #8420, #8421). pinging maintainers: @oliver @maya

oliver: I'll take PR #8421 (allocator change). starting a local reproducer: `pytest tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_eviction_logic -k shard2 -q --runslow`

maya: if you reproduce, try increasing `KV_CACHE_MAX=512MB` env to check if it's sizing related; also try `export CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` for deterministic traces

alex: if bisect points to the allocator change we should revert #8421, but confirm before flipping the revert. goal: either revert or hotpatch within 30m. :thumbsup:

jen: I'll open a draft revert PR now so it's ready to merge if confirmed and will paste link here

sam: adding triage label to the failing builds and paging the infra oncall to monitor

ci-bot: daily flake tally: kv_cache failures increased (2 -> 12) in last 30m :warning:

ops-bot: note added to incident log and autoscaler threshold temporarily adjusted

oliver: quick update — reproducer started and hitting same assertion locally. will try to bisect to the exact commit in #8421 and report in ~12m

jen: any objections to merging a revert if bisect confirms? no objections -> proceed

alex: acknowledged. coordinating reproducer & revert if needed. pulling full GPU traces now.

jen: thanks everyone, I'll stand by to merge revert or close it if bisect clears my PR.
